messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — we still have 4 open remediation items from the authz incident. Need owners + firm dates so SRE can schedule. Who's taking ownership?
aj: I can take the token-validation end-to-end: re-run validations, add alerts for drift. I'll own ACTION-901. Target EOD 2026-04-02. @kevin want me to coordinate with infra?
kevin: thanks @aj. Yes, please coordinate. I'll handle the CI job to surface token TTL expiries in Prometheus. Plan to push a small exporter by Thu.
sam: I'll pick up audit-log retention misconfig (ACTION-902). Short summary: retention policy in prod logging got removed after the logging migration. Plan is to restore 365d retention and add a monitor. ETA 2026-04-05.
natalie: I'm on secrets rotation failure investigation (ACTION-903). Root cause looks like a race in the rotation controller when multiple rotations coincide. Plan: add backoff + idempotency; will spike and open a PR. ETA 2026-04-07.
maria: good. Can we write minimal acceptance criteria for each action here? We need clear verification steps for postmortem closure (who verifies, what success looks like).
aj: acceptance: reproducible validation run that flags tokens with bad signatures or expired TTL; automated test that checks token validation lib versions inside images. test -> green in CI. Quick smoke command below.
aj: ```bash
# quick smoke to pull validation logs
kubectl logs -n auth deployment/auth-validator | grep "token: invalid" || true
```
kevin: acceptance for my exporter: grafana panel with token-expiry count + alert if > 0 for 5m. I'll add an alert rule and documentation in infra runbook.
sam: acceptance: confirm retention policy on prod index templates, run a restore check to ensure logs older than 90d are still queryable after patch. I'll post verification commands when done.
natalie: acceptance: rotation controller must retry >=3 with exponential backoff; add unit tests + e2e in canary namespace. Also emit metric `rotation_failures_total` with labels (namespace, service).
sec-bot: Automated scan finished: found 3 secrets in legacy format in `secrets-service` namespace — flagged as SENSITIVE. See https://ci.redwood/sec-scans/987 (scanner ID: s987).
maria: @sec-bot thx. @natalie please include clean-up of legacy-format secrets in your plan (delete old keys + rotate). Add the runbook link to the checklist.
natalie: will do. runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/secret-rotation. Adding cleanup step and quick verification commands.
aj: one more cross-cutting note: recurring pattern — token validation failures spike during release windows. Can we add a lightweight release-day auth-watch (oncall) and a canary smoke in the release pipeline?
kevin: agree. Suggest we create a "release-auth-watch" calendar entry for infra + SREs. Also will add a canary smoke to the release pipeline that exercises token validation and audit log writes.
maria: i've added a tracking sheet and linked this thread. ACTIONS summary to capture here: ACTION-901 (aj, token validation, due 2026-04-02), ACTION-902 (sam, audit retention, due 2026-04-05), ACTION-903 (natalie, secrets rotation + cleanup, due 2026-04-07), ACTION-904 (kevin, exporter + alert, due 2026-04-01). I'll follow up next Tue in #incidents for status. :calendar:
sam: ack. I'll paste verification snippet once I've patched templates.
kevin: PR #4870 will include exporter + alert rule and grafana dashboard. I'll post link when available.
natalie: spinning up a branch now and will include unit tests + metric. Will ping when review ready.
maria: great work. Closing loop: once each action has acceptance notes and linked PR/runbook, we'll mark the postmortem resolved and update the postmortem doc. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
